question: In which year was Tata Iron and Steel Company Limited (TISCO) established in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1907**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Tata Iron and Steel Company Limited (TISCO), now known as Tata Steel, was established in the year **1907**.
 
• The company was founded by the visionary Indian industrialist **Jamsetji Tata** in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand.
 
• TISCO was one of the first integrated steel plants in Asia and played a crucial role in the industrialization of India.
 
• Tata Steel is now one of the leading steel manufacturers in the world, known for its high-quality products and sustainable practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jamsetji Tata**

 
 
• Jamsetji Tata was an Indian pioneer industrialist who founded the Tata Group, India's biggest conglomerate company.
 
• He is regarded as the "Father of Indian Industry" due to his significant contributions to the country's industrial sector.
 
• His vision included establishing an iron and steel plant, a hydroelectric plant, and an educational institution, all of which have left a lasting legacy.
 
 
 
• **Jamshedpur**
 
 
• Jamshedpur, named after Jamsetji Tata, is a city in Jharkhand, India, and is known as the "Steel City" due to the presence of Tata Steel.
 
• The city is one of the first planned industrial cities in India and is known for its infrastructure and quality of life.
 
 
 
• **Steel Industry in India**
 
 
• The steel industry is a critical sector in India's economy, providing employment to millions and contributing significantly to the GDP.
 
• India is one of the largest producers of steel in the world, and companies like Tata Steel have played a pivotal role in this achievement.
 
 
 
• **Tata Steel**
 
 
• Tata Steel is a multinational steel-making company headquartered in Mumbai, India, and a subsidiary of the Tata Group.
 
• It operates in 26 countries with key operations in India, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom.
 
• The company is known for its innovative products, sustainable practices, and commitment to social responsibility.
